description: Utility pages: Client Access, Careers, Privacy and Terms, on the internal page shell (page-shell.php). Honest, minimal content: no client login is implied, no vacancies are invented, and Privacy and Terms state only what the site does until the legal copy is supplied.

meta.summit_standfirst: Secure access to shared project information is available to clients with an active account.

Good work depends on people who think carefully, speak plainly and take responsibility for the outcome. We value independent judgement, curiosity and the ability to work across disciplines without mistaking breadth for expertise.
When you contact Summit, subscribe to our research or request a report, you should know what information is requested and why.
meta.summit_intro: Our Privacy Policy explains how personal information is handled, who to contact about it and the choices available to you.

meta.summit_standfirst: Summit publishes articles, research and information about its work. The material is provided for general information unless we expressly agree otherwise.
meta.summit_intro: Our Terms explain the conditions governing use of the website, its material and its interactive features.
